title: Reference approach: Fine-Tuned Image Recognition Model
approach: Build Fine-Tuned Image Recognition Model in small milestones. Implement: Replace the classification head; Freeze and unfreeze layers in stages; Checkpoint and restore safely; Report class-wise metrics; Validate inference on uploaded images. Use synthetic data while developing, choose a documented dataset for the final experiment, and keep train/validation/test splits separate.

reference_snippets.code:
import torch
from torch import nn
model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(8, 16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(16, 2)).eval()
with torch.inference_mode():
    output = model(torch.zeros(1, 8))
assert output.shape == (1, 2)
print("smoke test passed")
